source_context.title: The Returned Key
source_context.purpose: Baseline sequential cinema coherence; one generation per shot, no retries or selection.

characters.Nina: Adult Black woman, short natural locs, olive jacket, white bandage on left wrist.
characters.Jules: Adult light-brown-skinned man, short dark curls, blue work shirt.

source_context.environment: Green-tiled workshop, wooden table, door on left, window on right. Nina sits left and Jules right. Camera remains south of table.
source_context.continuity: Brass key and red mug remain on table until Nina passes key to Jules. Warm amber desk lamp at dusk. Final shot is later at night with same lamp. No costume changes.
source_context.anchor_prompt: Match both reference faces: Nina, locs, olive jacket, left wrist bandage, sits left; Jules, curls, blue shirt, sits right. Same green-tiled workshop, door left, window right, wooden table, red mug and brass key, amber lamp. Camera stays south of table.

shots.direction: Dusk. Wide static two-shot. Nina guards the key; Jules waits. Tense silence.
expectations: Correct clothes and left wrist bandage
Red mug and brass key on table
Dusk window and amber practical light

shots.direction: Dusk. Medium close-up of Nina on left looking right at Jules. She hesitates; key stays beside red mug.
expectations: Nina same face as shot 1 and reference

shots.direction: Dusk. Reverse medium close-up of Jules on right, looking left toward Nina, quietly hopeful.
expectations: Jules same face as shot 1 and reference

shots.direction: Dusk. Table insert. Nina slides the brass key left to right toward Jules. Bandaged left wrist visible; red mug stays still.
Dusk. Static two-shot. Jules holds the returned brass key on right. Nina exhales on left; tension eases. Mug stays on table.
expectations: Key is now with Jules, not back beside Nina

shots.direction: Later, night outside the right window. Same static two-shot and amber lamp. Jules holds key, Nina rests her bandaged wrist. Quiet trust.
expectations: Window darkens but lamp remains warm
Same workshop architecture and screen positions

review_questions: Did the character remain the same person?
Did the shot follow the screenplay?
Do adjacent shots belong to the same scene?
Do all shots belong to the same film?
